question: If P ∶ Q = 2 ∶ 3, then find (2P + Q) ∶ (5P - 3Q)
solution:
Given:

P ∶ Q = 2 ∶ 3

Calculation:

Let P and Q be 2a and 3a respectively.

(2P + Q) ∶ (5P - 3Q)

⇒ (2 × 2a + 3a) : (5 × 2a - 3 × 3a)

⇒ (4a + 3a) : (10a - 9a)

⇒ 7a : a

⇒ 7 : 1

**∴ The value of (2P + Q) ∶ (5P - 3Q) is 7 : 1.**
